headline: DeepSeek hits 24.9% in historic surge; stealth tumbles
summary: DeepSeek's v4.1-flash just set an all-time token-share record at 24.9%, vaulting to #1 with a 9.9-point gain in a single day. stealth's space-bunny-alpha dropped hard, losing 13.3 points to fall to #2. The top two providers now command 47.3% of the market between them.
highlights: DeepSeek v4.1-flash hits 24.9% token share—an all-time high
stealth space-bunny-alpha plummets 13.3 points to 16.2%, ceding the crown
DeepSeek provider share jumps to 31.1% (+10.2 points in one day)
OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna slides to #16, down 10 spots in a week
Three new entrants: upstage solar-pro4, xAI grok-4.7, Google gemma-4-26b
